mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT gg.dept_id as org_id, gg.dept_name as org_name, gg.dept_level as org_level, gg.parent_id as parent_org_id, dd.device_code, IFNULL(rel.device_name, de.device_name) AS device_name, concat(gg.dept_level + 1) AS devLevel, 'false' AS checked, de.longitude, de.latitude, 1 AS num, de.site_id site_code,de.resource_status device_status, case when IFNULL(dct.user_device_coll_id, 0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end isMonitor, de.position_fix uavNestPositionFix, de.calibration_status uavNestCalibrationStatus FROM sys_dept gg LEFT JOIN vm_organ_device_rel_t dd ON gg.dept_id = dd.dept_id and dd.device_type = 15 and gg.industry_code = dd.industry_code LEFT JOIN vm_uav_nest_device_info de ON dd.device_code = de.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_user_device_collection_t dct ON dct.coll_obj_code = de.device_code AND dct.coll_obj_type = '15' and dct.user_id = #{param.userId} left join vm_order_uav_nest_devices vod on vod.industry_code = dd.industry_code and vod.device_code = de.device_code and vod.tenant_id = gg.tenant_id LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t rel ON rel.device_code = vod.device_code and rel.tenant_id = vod.tenant_id and rel.industry_code = vod.industry_code and rel.delete_flag = '0' and rel.device_type = 4 WHERE gg.del_flag = '0' AND dd.delete_flag = '0' AND de.delete_flag = '0' AND dd.device_code IS NOT NULL AND dd.device_code != '' AND vod.delete_flag = '0' AND vod.ord_status in (0,1,2)
and dct.user_device_coll_id IS NOT NULL
and de.resource_status != 2
and de.resource_status = #{param.deviceStatus}
and de.resource_status in
#{item}
${param.dataScope} ORDER BY gg.dept_id,dd.device_code

select uav.device_code, (case when length(IFNULL(rel.device_name, '')) = 0 then uav.device_name else rel.device_name end ) deviceName, uav.resource_status device_status, uav.model_code, model.model_name, uav.manufacturer_code, (SELECT DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data WHERE DICT_TYPE = 'uav_nest_manufacturer' AND DICT_VALUE = uav.manufacturer_code LIMIT 1) manufacturerName, uav.province_code, uav.city_code, uav.county_code, uav.town_code, uav.address location, uav.longitude, uav.latitude, uav.altitude, uav.hanging_height as height, uav.position_fix uavNestPositionFix, uav.calibration_status uavNestCalibrationStatus, uav.location_code access_node, pro.area_name as provinceName, city.area_name as cityName, county.area_name as countyName, town.area_name as townName, uav.site_id site_code, case when IFNULL(dct.user_device_coll_id,0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end isMonitor from vm_uav_nest_device_info uav LEFT JOIN sys_area pro ON pro.area_code = uav.province_code LEFT JOIN sys_area city ON city.area_code = uav.city_code LEFT JOIN sys_area county ON county.area_code = uav.county_code LEFT JOIN sys_area town ON town.area_code = uav.town_code left join vm_uav_nest_device_model_t model on model.model_code = uav.model_code and model.delete_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t rel ON rel.device_code = uav.device_code and rel.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and rel.industry_code = #{industryCode} and rel.delete_flag = '0' and rel.device_type = 4 LEFT JOIN vm_user_device_collection_t dct ON dct.coll_obj_code = uav.device_code and dct.coll_obj_type = '15' AND dct.user_id = #{userId} where uav.device_code = #{deviceCode} and uav.delete_flag = '0' and exists(select od.id from vm_order_uav_nest_devices od join sys_tenant_info ti on od.tenant_id = ti.tenant_id where od.device_code = uav.device_code and od.delete_flag ='0' and ti.del_flag = '0' and od.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and od.industry_code = #{industryCode} )
